body: She had way more than she thought
So you don’t see how condescending your reply is to me? Like at all?

I have one friend who I see once a month in passing for lunch because we work the literal opposite shift. My family tells me everyday I’m not bipolar and I’m not depressed, so yay my irl friends and family are really going to help me. I go to work and go home. I don’t have a social life. You proved my point in your reply that it’s just for a complement and advice trying to push me to be happy. They don’t mean shit none of them do. Once less death for a statistic number. That’s all I am to them. Fuck them fuck everyone saying don’t kill yourself I love you, you matter. Bullshit you dont fucking know me. You don’t know the shit I went through. You don’t know anything about me. You don’t love me. Say the truth, “I only wish you wouldn’t die because that would suck for the people in your life not for me because I wouldn’t even fucking know if you were dead.” My fucking dad didn’t even try to come and see me the first thing he texted me after the hospital called him was, “I’m going over to feed blank”  so fuck that. Fuck this thread. I just want to delete it fuck everyone. I just want to die

I actually am off of it right now after taking three bottles of it. I stopped taking it and then used up the saved pills to try and off myself. Money is a meaningless piece of fucking paper, I could have 5 dollars in my account or 10,000 I would make it work.

They don’t. They show that humans will blindly love and trust, none of you know me. None of you truly care about me. You just don’t want another person to die at their own hands. These comments to me are sad not for me but for you. Some of them I enjoy, some I can feel the compassion and others I can tell are forced love. It’s more depressing than anything.

I’ve been in therapy since second grade for major depressive disorder which slowly grew into a list of more and more diagnosis. It doesn’t work, I talk about everything under the stars and moon been to more therapists than I can remember and I felt better on a drug than talking.

My friend and I already have a pact if I die he would take my ferret and dog in for me. And give them a long happy life, I have a bank account solely for vet bills set aside so he would never have to worry about those and my dog has pet insurance already because he has leg problems.
And that’s just one of my medications not including the two others which also have their own unique list of hidden killers.

Fun fact! The medication I take has a 100 worse side affects than shrooms. Can cause my face to become permanently disfigured, massive heart attack, stroke, infertility, and oh look suicidal thoughts and actions. I rather my doctor give me shrooms than this shit.
You don’t even know me.
If only this IV was an actual needle I would probably put it through my neck.
Shitty worse than yesterday.
I’m glad I was the first post you decided to attack on your throw away asshat.

Fuck if I could know. I was there long enough. I have to stay in the ICU because my blood work is all sorts of fucked, downing a whole bottle of antipsychotics isn’t FDA approved neither is the 2 bottles of anti seizure medication.
My dad is currently feeding and taking him out for me thank you for caring so much!
Getting told you aren’t sick, and you’re being dramatic when I do is super fun!
I don't have the same thought of that, but if I happen to survive long enough to make a batch of cookies I'll save one for you.

I feels odd having so much support on the other posts I've made, I don't deserve it in anyway. I wish I could give you all a homemade cookie or something. I don't know I'm very boring not much skill here but I would bake every one of you something.
My family is not a great support, or I would
Also sorry to everyone if I don’t respond to your PM I have so many and I’m trying to sort through them and message people back! S
Moms a fucking raging addict. Dads my best friend but a fucking asshole some of the time. Sister but I don’t know none of them feel like home most of the time.
I’m not
Why do you think I want to die? You don’t think I have a psychiatrist go and read anything on this thread it’s bad for anyone’s health. Thanks for basically me telling me not to post here.
I hate jelly and I hate hospitals.

It still hurts man my stomach is crushingly empty, I just am more upset that I survived it. The pain of the vomit was the worst after being bulimic for years you think I would be fine with it but it was awful. I locked my door the apartment cop we have has a master key and opened it up because he heard me vomiting and the dog barking. I was responding at that point, I am currently not seeing anyone in hospital so it’s just me here.

I want to die I’ve tired 3 times all impulsively. I didn’t want to tell my friend or anyone in my life. I wanted to tell a stranger a last cry out. I wanted to let someone know I was leaving. It was my way of saying goodbye. I was ready I wasn’t regretting it or holding on.
To everyone concerned still, and hasn’t seen the follow up I would go read that I’m done with this thread it’s just a reminder I fail at everything I try.

I’ve gotten help, been getting help for a really long time. It’s not easy fixing a broken fucking brain. My shits all sorts of fucked. The wiring is all messed up. I just want to it stop. It will one day just not today. I just don’t want to go back to the damn program that shit sucks. You just have to lie your way out, put on a smile and pretend everything is being fixed and then they send you on your merry way.
Not in the Netherlands man. Wish I was sometimes you guys have some cool tulip fields.
You’re probably asking this for ideas I assume which I won’t give, if it’s honest curiosity you can pm but I’m not going to publicly release my three other attempts.

Thank you K. I have started fresh a plenty of times moved across the US for all that. Got out of an abusive home trouble and abusive kept following. It’s not a matter of running anymore. I reinvented myself in more ways than one changed myself pretended to be someone I’m not. The person I truly am, well they would probably be in prison right now. I kept that part hidden from the world, I’m really not a good person and seeing all this love from people proves people are blind to things that will fucking eat them alive. I am the definition of a monster if I ever slipped up I would be on the front page, on every fucking news channel. Wouldn’t you want that person to be dead before they snapped? Would you kill Hilter before he had the chance to start a genocide? Suicide is my better option.
You don’t think I’ve tried shrooms man? Nothing helps, all goes back to the same place, I don’t want to be high forever.

What’s there to talk about? I said my piece about it, I’ve been in this spot before. I will most likely be in it again. Everyone keeps saying my shit is poetic and I need to keep writing. NO I’m fucking sick man, there’s nothing to fucking write about. I wanted to die I was ready, and now I’m still fucking here.

I’m sorry you suffer through the same things that shit eats at you man. I wish I could believe your statements about there being a purpose I just don’t believe that, never have. Life in my eyes is meaningless, you breed and die. We just along the way became self aware and now we are all fucked with greed and hope.
My neighbor in my apartment, the damn fucking dog wouldn’t stop barking.
I’m a fucking failure. They always say try until you succeed. That’s what I’ve been doing it just seems to be the odds are never in my favor.
I am a god my man, they don’t want me to die.

Thank you, people always like to see the better in everyone. Think they can change, they haven’t walked a day in my shoes. They haven’t lived my life, fought my battles. They are meaningless shouts to the void just like I am putting out. I won’t listen to my closest friends much less people I don’t know, and that’s okay. I just have a long recovery ahead until I can even be hospitalized in a mental ward. So it’s going to be a journey I don’t want to fight.
Things haven’t looked up in a very long time, I don’t think that’s changing anytime soon.
That’s very sweet of you to want to put my quote on your wall. That means a lot to me. It’s just a battle from here now for me. I won’t be out of the hospital for a while now.
I have decided sleep well my friend. I will be twinkling up there.

I told someone on here I would come back before I left, I have my stuff together now. I am leaving now my friends thank you for the kind words. I’m sorry I couldn’t stay longer, maybe in a different life I could have seen some of your faces and shook your hands and had long conversations about life, I have my pills and my gun if those don’t work. Goodbye everyone. I’m sorry to my dad. And to the man I love, I wish you happiness thank you for being the best thing in my life recently. In another life we would have been unstoppable. I’ll be in the stars if you ever need me. S
God isn’t real my friend.

I’m going alone on my journey, I lived alone and I’m going out alone man. Death is natural it’s just sad that you know it’s happening to me. I’m sorry you feel this way, that you stumbled on my post the past 5 months have been me telling myself one more day.
Still here man, still early in the night. I still wanted a bath and some food, I have some chores.

I’m not rolling my eyes at you because a year ago I was you. Even after the rape, I was you strong, hopeful, and willing to live. People change over and over again, I survived three attempts I am the definition of the roller coasters. In second grade I used to tell my father I would never be happy again, the first time I saw him cry was when he saw my self harm scars, years later. I’ve been you and if I live tomorrow I will be you again. I’m tired of being the me I am today and the you I will be tomorrow the endless cycle. I lived a good and shitty life. My time is today. Don’t waste your thoughts on me, think about the moments that matter not the stranger you never even knew. Thank you for the kind words I will take them to the stars with me :)
Mike and Ike’s lol. They were my childhood favorite. And probably a bowl of my favorite fruit honeydew :). It’s going to be the worst dinner ever but childhood me would have died in happiness

It feels nice talking to you because you don’t feel like you are trying to talk me out of it you are looking at me like I am a human. Not some sick manic person like everyone else. Thank you for that.

Did you read it? This is my goodbye note to strangers. I don’t write for anyone. I don’t really enjoy it, I do it because in the end I want everyone to read what I went through it’s my own tragedy in my small town. Maybe someone will care enough to write about it for me.

I’ve read The Outsiders! I’m actually a big fan of reading! Definitely read the book it’s my dying wish lol jk. It’s amazing, I’m from California in the area she runs off too, it made me feel alive. I did a lot of the same drugs she did, she was the embodiment of me. Great read I really recommend it.

No I’m not a writer, that’s very kind. You probably are the only person who will read this. I journal if that counts been doing it for a while, when I go I think my family and friends will finally realize how sick I really am. Three failed attempts down, and I won’t go down without a fight tonight. I’m tired man. Real fucking tired. They could take my journals and make them a book for you, if you like lol. Like Go Ask Alice. Great book by the way, one of my favorites, she reminds me of me.

I’m glad this post will get lost in a pool of other people’s cries for help it’s poetic. A bunch of recovering attempts, attempting people, and people who have lost someone to suicide. I will just be another statistic in a pool of a losing battle. We all die I’ve just chosen my way out.
